title: What It Actually Looks Like to Work Hard and Rest Like You Trust God
caption:
A godly man works like it's worship and rests like he actually trusts God. Both are obedience. Neither is optional.

Do the task you'd skip if no one was watching, first. Show up on the slow days, not just the exciting ones. Rest isn't a reward you earn, it's a rhythm you were built for. And let your work actually end at the door.

What you can't put down owns you.

#faith #discipline #godlymen #christianman #rest #sabbath #manofgod
